rule: Alert = a token that graduated 10-60 min after launch, launched 7 AM-4:59 PM LA, first seen at $100k. Entry = $100 buy 60 s after the alert. Exit = 3x or 72 h after the crossing.
history: Backfill (Aug 12-Sep 7, 157 tokens): $128 per $100 with this rule vs $102 for everything else; about 1 in 10 hit 3x; 60 % still lose more than half. Interim readout at 120 alerts / Sep 30, final at 240 / Oct 31.
